import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 5, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (5, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = pd.Categorical([f'Group{v+1}' for v in k])
df.shape

steps.name: label by cluster column
steps.eval: const col = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'cluster'); const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); sel.value = String(col.index); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: switch to around-the-map mode
steps.eval: const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label style"]'); sel.value = 'around'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: leader lines appear between anchors and labels (pixel check)
switch to curved leaders
steps.eval: const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Leader style"]'); sel.value = 'curved'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: switch to wedge leaders
steps.eval: const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Leader style"]'); sel.value = 'wedge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: switch back to straight leaders, grey color
steps.eval: const lsSel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Leader style"]'); lsSel.value = 'straight'; lsSel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); const lcSel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Leader color"]'); lcSel.value = 'grey'; lcSel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: switch back to over mode
steps.eval: const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label style"]'); sel.value = 'over'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
